title: BoldCreate plugin metadata
description: Extra metadata BoldCreate Connect needs that the Cursor and Claude manifests have no field for.

phase.description: Rollout phase this plugin belongs to.

wave.description: Test wave. A = token or no auth, B = OAuth.

transport.description: MCP transport. BoldCreate Connect supports streamable-http only today.

auth.description: Auth this package is configured for. env = credential passed to a local (stdio) server as an environment variable.

alternativeAuth.description: Other auth methods the server supports.

upstream.description: Where vendored or launched components come from, so updates can be traced.

package.description: Package the component runs, as <registry>:<name>, e.g. nuget:Foo or npm:@scope/foo.

ref.description: Commit SHA, tag, or package version.
